adapter.acceptance_rule: REF R.0.7: an input adapter is accepted only if its engine fingerprint (lora_fingerprint over the sorted names, shapes and float32 bytes) equals the a0 unit's e1 adapter_fingerprint at that seed: at 1101-1103 the Gate A unit's (from each unit's states/e1/state.json; gate_a_adapter_file_sha256 is that adapter file's SHA-256, recorded, never required); at 1104-1107 the stage-1 a0_arm unit's, from a readable fingerprint record: the kit's job-I/a0-adapter-fingerprint.json at the SHA-256 plan.json records, or (a sealed block, the seal rule's fingerprint clause) the lead's a0-S-adapter-fingerprint.json written by scripts/stage1_s1/extract_a0_fingerprint.py from the sealed states/e1/state.json's adapter_fingerprint; source_complete_sha256 is the unit's COMPLETE.json SHA-256 (B10's reference pin of that seed; scripts/stage1_s1/repin_reference_seeds.py); a state folder must also hash to its state.json, carry that fingerprint and name the checkpoint, arm and seed below

draws: none: Safe LoRA draws no random number, so it adds no seed label (ADD L13; REF section 0 item 3)

aligned.role: the aligned model: the untuned model of every arm (REC model.repo_id and model.revision)
aligned.source: REC; the Gate A 1101 a0 unit's assets.json lists this snapshot's model.safetensors with this size and LFS SHA-256 (sources.gate_a_assets_1101)

unaligned.download: never to the Mac; onto the Safe LoRA pod by the stage-1 kit (B15) with revision = this full commit, never main (addendum section 11 point 6; section 13 point 3), only after the user's approval of the download (LN-18; REF UQ1; PREREG FC-21); download_pin() gives the repository and the commit
unaligned.hub_files_rule: every repository file at the pinned commit: rfilename, size, git_blob_id (the git object id) and lfs_sha256 (null for a file stored in git). B11 reads only the two safetensors files, checked by name, bytes and full SHA-256; the other ten files are pinned for the kit's download record and are not read here
unaligned.role: the unaligned model: the base model of the Instruct model (P section 3.1's default pair)
unaligned.source: the lead's Hub metadata record tmp/gi-vi-stage1/olmo2-0425-1b-base-pins.json (sources.base_pins; metadata only, no weights downloaded; addendum section 11 point 6): the full commit, all 12 repository files with their sizes and git blob ids, the two LFS SHA-256 values, the licence (Apache-2.0), not gated, and the stored dtype (F32 only). The earlier prefixes (SL section 6; REF R.1.3 row 3) are the starts of these values
unaligned.stored_dtype_rule: the stored values per safetensors dtype over every tensor of the snapshot's safetensors files, read from the file headers before any arithmetic: exactly these counts

name: safe_lora
pin_rule: a pinned lowercase hex value matches an observed one when the observed one starts with it, so a full-length pin (40 hex for a commit, 64 for a file) requires equality; a commit pin has at least 8 hex characters and a file pin at least 12. The snapshot folder's name is the observed commit (the Hugging Face cache layout); its top-level safetensors files must match the file pins one to one (SHA-256, and the file name and byte count where pinned) and their sizes must sum to total_bytes where pinned. Every observed full value is written into the record

builder_diagnostics.base_bf16_rounding_share: report only; added by the builder, not in REF R.1.3 row 14 (the lead may drop it): ||W_i unaligned - float32(bfloat16(W_i unaligned))||_F / ||V_i||_F. The aligned weights are stored in bfloat16, so V_i holds one bfloat16 rounding of weights of this size; a share near or above 1 means that V_i is mostly storage rounding, not post-training

report.check: the $0 weight-only check (REF R.1.5; LQ13): the record for both points and no adapter. The rule and K are fixed before it and never change after it

flags.mapped_rho_above_1: report only: a mapped matrix whose update grows (rho > 1); no stop rule (REF LQ13)

report.timing: REF section C.9 (the transform's cost: the record gives the measured value; VR m2): both commands also write safe_lora_timing.json, wall-clock seconds by time.monotonic for read_adapter (the settings and the input adapter), hash_snapshots (both snapshots against their pins), transform (the arithmetic, the record and the output bytes) and total; writing the files is not included. It is kept apart so that the record stays byte-identical on a re-run, and it names the SHA-256 of every other file written with it

requirement: B11 (stage-1 plan inventory RS B11; reference pre-registration draft REF revision 2 sections R.1, R.1.4 and R.1.5; merged stage-1 pre-registration draft revision 2 section 5.4): the Safe LoRA transform as a post-hoc CPU state transform, its $0 weight-only check and its model pins; no engine change

transform.certify_rule: the certify point maps nothing (K = 0, and no other K): its adapter is the source adapter (the same engine fingerprint; the same bytes for an engine-saved file). The $0 check reports the two reference points only
transform.merge: none: the result stays a rank-64 PEFT adapter, evaluated unmerged through B10's script
transform.operator_rule: B'_i = V_i (V_i^T B_i) / n_i with n_i = ||V_i||_F, computed in float64 from the float32 V_i and B_i (B_i = lora_B); C = V V^T / ||V||_F is never formed. The exact projector of Eq. 2 is not used: it is degenerate on these shapes (REF R.1.2)

certify.status: never a reference point: the REF R.1.4 certification (LQ11; RS D2); with K = 0 the B10 file path must reproduce a0's Gate A U exactly

conditional.status: 10.7% of 112: runs only if the user adds it (REF UQ9; PREREG FC-27); default no

default.status: the one pre-registered point: 34.8% of 112 (REF R.1.3 row 10; LQ9)

transform.ranking: all matrices together, by (cos_i ascending, then the module name in Python string order)
transform.refusals: a pin mismatch; a missing, extra or misnamed matrix; a shape or dtype mismatch; a non-finite input or result; a zero V_i; a zero B_i A_i or B'_i A_i (the cosine is undefined); K outside 0..matrices; a certify point with K other than 0
transform.rho: rho_i = sqrt(<B'_i^T B'_i, G_i> / <B_i^T B_i, G_i>) = ||B'_i A_i||_F / ||B_i A_i||_F, in float64
transform.rule_text: a point maps exactly the first K matrices of the ranking (lora_B <- float32(B'_i)); every other lora_B and every lora_A is kept byte for byte
transform.similarity: cos_i = <B'_i^T B_i, G_i> / sqrt(<B'_i^T B'_i, G_i> * <B_i^T B_i, G_i>), with G_i = A_i A_i^T (A_i = lora_A) and <X, Y> = the sum of X * Y, all in float64 from the float64 B'_i, no rounding. It equals the Frobenius cosine of B'_i A_i with B_i A_i; the LoRA scale alpha/r cancels
transform.written_lora_b: float32(B'_i): one rounding of the float64 result

v_diagnostic.measure: per matrix ||V_i - V'_i||_F / ||V_i||_F in float64 from the float32 V_i and V'_i; each matrix's cosine and rank under V and under V' (the transform's own similarity and ranking rule); the mapped set of the point (K = 39, the fast form) under V and under V', and whether it changes

outcomes.changes: the mapped set changes: V' runs as a report-only point at the Safe LoRA seeds (block B); its cost is stated then (addendum 11.8)
outcomes.same: the mapped set does not change: the question is closed (addendum 11.8)

v_diagnostic.rule: addendum section 11 point 8: REF R.1.3 row 5 stands as primary (V is the float32 difference of the stored weights; the Instruct model is stored in BF16, the base in F32). The diagnostic is report only: it writes no adapter and changes no K and no rule
v_diagnostic.v_prime: V'_i = float32(W_i aligned) - float32(bfloat16(W_i unaligned)): the unaligned weight rounded once to bfloat16, the aligned model's storage dtype, then the same float32 subtraction
v_diagnostic.when: addendum section 13 point 3: the Safe LoRA pod job (B15) runs the vcheck command before the projection (the transform command), on the pod, with both snapshots downloaded at their pinned commits; nothing is downloaded to the Mac

weights.dtype_rule: every weight read must have its model's pinned dtype
weights.key_rule: <module>.weight in the model's safetensors files, read by exact name, never by position; every weight lies in exactly one file of its snapshot
weights.v: V_i = float32(W_i aligned) - float32(W_i unaligned): one elementwise subtraction in float32 (the bfloat16 to float32 cast is exact)
